acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Ira talks about the time his dad taught him to shave, and how unusual that was.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: When Jackie read the obits for the man who had invented the famous Trapper Keeper notebook, she was very surprised. As far as she knew, the inventor was very much alive. It was her dad. Not the guy in the obit.
acts.title: Am I My Father's Trapper Keeper Keeper?

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc:
A father and son find themselves in a very traditional relationship. Until the end.
Rick McIntyre told this story in his book The Rise of Wolf 8: Witnessing the Triumph of Yellowstone's Underdog. He's now published four books about the wolves of Yellowstone. The second book in the series is all about 21’s life. It’s called The Reign of Wolf 21: The Saga of Yellowstone's Legendary Druid Pack.
acts.title: Raised By Wolf

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc:
Simon Rich reads his short story "History Report," in which a father explains the sex robots of the future. And other things as well.
Simon Rich's most recent book is New Teeth.

songs.a: Leon Thomas (radio) & “I Love My Dad” by Sun Kil Moon (podcast)

acts.title: Storycorps, the Post-Apocalypse Edition
